purpose.description: Your code attempts to implement the Fusion Kitchen inheritance project by modeling Restaurant, MexicanRestaurant, JapaneseRestaurant, and MexicanJapaneseFusion with menu management and overriding describeCuisine.
Main flow creates instances and calls displayInfo and describeCuisine, and uses add/display menu, aligning with task goals.

readability.description: Good use of includes and clear separation of header/source files. The class and method names are understandable.

A few naming and formatting inconsistencies reduce readability (e.g., spacing, underscores in comments removed, and consistent capitalization). Ensure consistent constructor parameter names and initializer lists.

performance.description: Basic use of vectors for menu is appropriate and efficient for small datasets.

Minor inefficiencies and potential issues in output formatting and object slicing risk when passing MenuItem by value may be avoided by const references in addMenuItem; also ensure virtual inheritance is correctly applied in the header declarations.
